# Model specification: timer 1.0.0

General/advanced timer as used by PX4 and ArduPilot for PWM outputs, the high-resolution timer tick and capture inputs.

## Features

| Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|
| base | Up-counting time base with prescaler, auto-reload, update event and interrupt. |
| pwm | Compare channels with PWM output to the actuator map. |
| capture | Input capture (RC input, timing). |
| dma | DMA on update (DShot, burst). |

## Terms

| Term | Kind | Feature | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| counter_enable | control | base | The counter runs. |
| prescaler | control | base | Counter clock = timer clock / (prescaler + 1). |
| auto_reload | control | base | Counter period = auto_reload + 1 counts (up-counting). |
| counter | status | base | Current count, computed from the clock when read. |
| update_event | status | base | Counter overflow or forced update. |
| force_update | control | base | Generates an update now and reloads preloaded registers. |
| preload | control | base | auto_reload / compare values take effect at the next update. |
| one_pulse | control | base | Counter stops at the next update. |
| flag_ack | ack | base | Clears update/compare/capture flags (write 0 to clear). |
| update_irq_enable | control | base | update_event raises irq. |
| irq | event | base | The timer's interrupt line(s) (Devicetree interrupts). |
| compare_value | control | pwm | Per channel compare value. |
| output_mode | control | pwm | Per channel: frozen, PWM mode 1, PWM mode 2, forced (others stored). |
| output_enable | control | pwm | Per channel output enable (and main output enable on advanced timers). |
| output_polarity | control | pwm | Per channel active high/low. |
| compare_event | status | pwm | Per channel compare match. |
| compare_irq_enable | control | pwm | Per channel compare_event raises irq. |
| pulse_output | event | pwm | Per channel pulse width delivered to the actuator map (athrill,pwm-actuator-map). |
| capture_select | control | capture | Per channel input capture on an edge. |
| capture_value | status | capture | Counter value at the captured edge. |
| capture_event | status | capture | Per channel capture happened. |
| update_dma_enable | control | dma | update_event raises the update DMA request (DShot). |
| update_dma_request | event | dma | Update DMA request. |

## Behaviour rules

| Rule | Feature | Rule text |
|---|---|---|
| ADV-TIM-B001 | base | While counter_enable is on, counter advances by one every (prescaler + 1) timer clocks and returns to 0 after auto_reload, raising update_event; reading counter returns the value at the read clock. |
| ADV-TIM-B002 | base | With preload, written auto_reload and compare values take effect at the next update; force_update applies them at once and sets update_event. |
| ADV-TIM-B003 | base | With one_pulse, counter_enable turns off at the next update. |
| ADV-TIM-B004 | pwm | In PWM mode 1 with output_enable, a channel is active from the counter's restart until counter reaches compare_value; its high time is compare_value x (prescaler+1) / timer clock and its period (auto_reload+1) x (prescaler+1) / timer clock (ADV-PWM-002); PWM mode 2 and output_polarity invert it. |
| ADV-TIM-B005 | pwm | The actuator map receives, for each mapped channel, the pulse width of the last complete period (ADV-PWM-001). |
| ADV-TIM-B006 | base | irq is raised while (update_irq_enable and update_event) or (compare_irq_enable and compare_event) of any channel; flag_ack clears flags. |
| ADV-TIM-B007 | capture | An edge on a capture channel copies counter to capture_value and sets capture_event. |
| ADV-TIM-B008 | dma | update_dma_request is raised at each update_event while update_dma_enable. |
| ADV-TIM-B009 | base | The timer clock is the bus timer clock of the MCU (with the timer clock multiplier of RCC); F7 and H7 differ and the map's constants state it. |

**Timing.** Updates and compare events happen at the clock their count is reached; nothing is ticked per count (computed lazily).

**Out of scope.** down/center-aligned counting, encoder mode, slave/master trigger chains, break and dead-time (stored only), repetition counter except as stored
